Set Sail for a More Casual Adventure!

Pirates Party is even more casual than current Store Tournament events and is designed to be easy for anyone to join. Whether you’ve just started playing or are thinking about trying the ONE PIECE CARD GAME for the first time.
Enjoy the ONE PIECE CARD GAME in a relaxed and friendly environment with your fellow NAKAMA!
One of the key features of Pirates Party is that each participating store can freely choose from four different formats when hosting the event.
New participation promo cards will be rolled out every two months, and a Welcome Pack will be introduced every half year.
The most-used Leader Cards in official tournaments are banned. The prohibited cards will be determined based on the environment prior to the start of the event.
Players can only use Straw Hat Pirate Crew related Leader Cards ! (Updated 17th Nov)
*The list of usable Leader Cards will be announced before the event period begins.
Search for a participating store near you on BANDAI TCG+!
Search for a local store on TCG+!
Find a local store on TCG+!
Prohibited Cards for Deck Limited Format
For this event, only Straw Hat Pirate Crew related Leader Cards may be used.
Alt-Art Cards can also be used.
TCG+ is a one-stop application for Bandai Card Games that includes finding a store near to you, registering for events, tournament attendance and pairings, deck building features, and statistics.
The tournament will be held in accordance with the Official Rules on the official website.
Please read the Official Rules and Q&A carefully before participating.

*If you have any questions about the rules during a battle, or if you have any doubts about whether or not something is correct, please raise your hand immediately and ask for a decision from the "staff" and follow their ruling. Please note that correct judgments cannot be made after the battle has progressed.
*Cards that are not legitimate, such as photocopied cards, cannot be used.
